sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
Tears that were shed by the Divine Child of Rejuvenation once she became the cradle. They are but frozen drops.
By having Kuro drink both the Dragon Tears and Frozen Tears, the Cradling ritual can be performed.
Cold Dragon Tears are just that.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - After giving this item to Wolf, the Divine Child will hand out Fine Snow, instead of Rice, at Sekiro's request for the rest of the playthrough.
